statements.T90: bound-lock/1 about="For a finite nonempty set of uniformly weighted admissible states at a fixed resolution, freedom is log2 of its cardinality, equal to its Shannon entropy. statements.T99: bound-lock/1 about="For a finite world with finite records, an acyclic dependency order and total supplied lattice operations, ancestry expansion visits each reachable name once and parts/meet perform finitely many operations. This is finite evaluation, not convergence of an arbitrary monotone-map iteration. Monotonicity alone allows a two-cycle from incomparable seeds. Every reachable dependency cycle is rejected; unreachable cycles do not affect the query. Arbitrary iterative convergence remains open without operator, seed and progress hypotheses.
